observed.facings.png: Three facings shown at one scale. South: a pale cream, leathery quadruped seen from the front, with its long drooping trunk-snout hanging down the middle and a pink tip. A bridle and reins are on the head. A large load of brown leather saddlebags, wicker panniers and an olive bedroll is strapped high on its back. It stands on thin knobbly legs with wide splayed toed pads. East: a side profile of the same animal. The neck is thrust forward roughly level, the long head ends in a drooping snout, and there is a heavy-lidded eye set back on the head. It wears a bridle and reins, carries the same full pack load, has thin stilt legs and broad 3-4-toed pads. North: the animal seen from behind. Rounded pale haunches, a short tail between them and a darker mottled spine ridge running up to the head, which sits at the top. Two lobes hang down either side of the head, like floppy ears or the sides of the head. No face or eyes are visible. Thin legs end in splayed toed pads. It has NO packs, saddlebags, bedroll or harness at all, so the back is bare.
observed.south.png: Front view. The face looks at the camera with two small eyes and a long trunk-like snout hanging down to a pink tip. A bridle crosses the face. observed.east.png: Side profile facing right. Short barrel body, a long level neck, and a head with a droopy snout curling down-forward. A heavy-lidded eye and a leather halter with dangling reins. observed.north.png: Rear view. Pale wrinkled haunches, a small tail, and a mottled darker ridge along the spine up to the back of the head.
